chunks: He said: Do not argue in My presence, for I had announced the promise of doom in advance.

key_terms.تَخْتَصِمُوا: to argue or dispute with one another

ai.seo_question: What does God tell the disbelievers to stop doing on the Day of Judgment in Surah Qaf?
ai.summary: In this verse, God addresses the disbelievers on the Day of Judgment, commanding them to cease their internal squabbles as they face the consequences of their denial. The phrase 'I have already sent the warning' underscores the Shia scholarly emphasis on the completeness of divine guidance through the Prophets, leaving no excuse for ignorance. This moment highlights the transition from the opportunity for repentance in the worldly life to the finality of judgment.
